duneborne.name: Oasis
duneborne.short: On a short rest, you or an ally can reroll a downtime move die and take the higher result.

freeborne.name: Unbound
freeborne.short: Once per session, when you roll with Fear, change it to Hope.

frostborne.name: Hardy
frostborne.short: When you take a rest, clear a Hit Point.

hearthborne.name: Close-Knit
hearthborne.short: Once per long rest, spend any number of Hope to give an ally within Far range that many Hope.

highborne.name: Privilege
highborne.short: Advantage on rolls to consort with nobles, negotiate prices, or leverage your reputation.

loreborne.name: Well-Read
loreborne.short: Advantage on rolls involving the history, culture, or politics of a prominent person or place.

orderborne.name: Dedicated
orderborne.short: Record three sayings or values from your upbringing. Once per rest, when your action embodies one, roll a d20 as your Hope Die.

reborne.name: Found Family
reborne.short: Once per rest, spend a Hope to use an ally's Experience as your own, describing how they prepared you for this moment.
When you join a new community or rediscover your old one, you can permanently trade this card for it.

ridgeborne.name: Steady
ridgeborne.short: Advantage on rolls to traverse dangerous cliffs and ledges, navigate harsh environments, and use survival knowledge.

seaborne.name: Know the Tide
seaborne.short: When you roll with Fear, place a token on your community card (max your level). Before an action roll, spend any number of tokens for +1 each. Clear unspent tokens at session end.

slyborne.name: Scoundrel
slyborne.short: Advantage on rolls to negotiate with criminals, detect lies, or find a safe place to hide.

underborne.name: Low-Light Living
underborne.short: In low light or heavy shadow, advantage on rolls to hide, investigate, or perceive details there.

wanderborne.name: Nomadic Pack
wanderborne.short: Add a Nomadic Pack to your inventory. Once per session, spend a Hope to pull a useful mundane item from it (work with the GM).

warborne.name: Brave Face
warborne.short: Once per session, when you would mark a Stress, spend a Hope instead.

wildborne.name: Lightfoot
wildborne.short: Your movement is silent. Advantage on rolls to move without being heard.
